values.note: 'BOOK ONLINE' on the park's rates page goes to RoverPass. One-night minimum; charges go through at least 10 days before arrival, and cancelling with less than 7 days' notice (two weeks for special events or holidays) costs the whole reservation. Seasonal and group rates by phone.

booking.source: https://lakechalet.com/camping/ ('BOOK ONLINE' -> roverpass.com/c/lake-chalet-campground-bridgewater-ny/reservations/; 'One Night Minimum – Charges for reservation must be put through at least 10 days before reservation date'; 'Less than 7 days notice – Full Reservation Charge'; 'CALL for Seasonal Rates and Group Rates'), read 2026-10-21

note: Motel and campground at 593 Route 8, Bridgewater, on a 6-acre private lake with a sandy beach, the lake and a brook both stocked for fishing; the tent sites sit between the lake and the brook. 17 sites have 30/50-amp electric and water, 10 have full hookups and 40 are for tents, plus 6 cabins and the motel. Honey-wagon service; paddle boats, canoes and kayaks; pets are welcome but not on the beach or in the lake. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 67 sites (17 W/E 30/50-amp, 10 full hookup, 40 tent), $45 partial / $50 full hookup for 4 people (+$5 per extra person 6+), matching the RoverPass fees read 2026-10-14, phone (315) 822-6074, online booking through RoverPass. Added the booking link and cancellation terms. Note trimmed of facility text the fields hold. Not stated by the operator: season dates (RoverPass's May 1 - Oct 15 left), site lengths.
flags: Price gate: base $45/night (partial hookup, 4 people) under US$50; RoverPass adds its own $10 platform fee once per booking (not counted). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here. Long-stay test passes: nightly rates posted, one-night minimum, seasonal rates by phone only.
